purpose: Test whether repeated exposure lets an owned trainable tail learn the committed new facts while preserving established answers.
schedule: Repeat the original 128 exact ordered batches eight times. Preserve microbatch grouping, padding, tokenization, loss weights, reference KL and margin. No new training examples or evaluation records.
prerequisite_rule: Require exact real-model feature factorization in both arms and completed failure of every original short-run candidate, with no original final selected or opened.
selection_rule: Only each arm's terminal update 1024 may qualify, using every original development gate. Both arms must finish before selection is committed. Only eligible arms may open the still-unused original knowledge final; previously exposed skill and conversation finals measure retention. Keep learning success and capacity advantage as separate claims.
stop_rule: Abort on numerical, ownership, input-integrity or resource-bound failure; otherwise complete exactly 1024 updates. Do not extend training or tune from development/final results within this experiment.
scope: Operated numerical learning experiment. No issuance, serving promotion, public consensus change or claim of broad assistant quality. Eight passes give each fact 96 target exposures: eight question targets and four narrative targets per pass.
